thread:
Elaine (PM): Quick sync - need a lightweight routing/playbook for design partner feedback. Goal: auto-route to owners, minimize manual triage.
Ravi (Eng): Clarify outputs: GitHub issue, DM, or internal tracker?
Ashley (ProdOps): For initial cohort (20 partners) -> GitHub issue + ping owner. Manual only for P0.
Morgan (Design): We should tag by type: usability, latency, hallucination, docs, security.
Elaine (PM): Draft flow: intake form -> tagger (rules first) -> route map -> notify per partner preference.
Ravi (Eng): Rule-based tagger MVP. Log predictions + provide override.
recruit-bot: Reminder: ensure NDAs & log consent before ingesting partner data.
Ashley (ProdOps): Intake fields: contact, use-case, traffic, can-share-logs (yes/no), preferred cadence.
Morgan (Design): Add a short example prompt + expected output in intake to help triage regressions.
Elaine (PM): Success metrics: MTTR to owner <30m for P1, partner satisfaction >=4/5 at 2-week check-in, <10% misroutes.
Ravi (Eng): Implementation plan: Week1 intake + tagging rules; Week2 GH integration + DM; Week3 logging + UI checkbox for "routed correctly?"
Ashley (ProdOps): Incentives: priority support + $500 credit for partners who opt into sharing logs.
Morgan (Design): Add 2-week micro-survey: usefulness (1-5), solved (yes/no).
Elaine (PM): Action items: @Ravi prototype rule-tagger by Tue; @Ashley finalize intake & consent by Wed; @Morgan mock UI checkbox & survey by Thu. Rolling to 5 partners canary after internal review.
Ravi (Eng): +1
Ashley (ProdOps): +1
Morgan (Design): +1
recruit-bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled in 7 days.
